high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "seekersofthecosmos." The post features a headline that reads: "Google has mapped a piece of human brain in the most detail ever." Below the headline, there are two images side by side. The left image appears to be a grayscale microscopic view of a section of the human brain, showing various cells and structures. The right image is a colorful, three-dimensional rendering of neural connections, likely representing synapses, with different colors indicating different types or states of neural activity.
